notes.title: Update 1.0.1a Added tutorial Button
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1a (04/06/2024)

[list]
[*] We have added a 'Tutorial Button' within the game, although not much. But hopefully it will help you understand the game faster on your first play.
[*] Added a description button for the visual information displayed on the right side of the game.
[/list]
